Light, mirrors and windows

Even light and surfaces with detail give the sharpest walkthrough. Mirrors and glass reflect, so give them less of the view.

  1. Turn on every light before you start, and keep lights, doors and furniture unchanged until you finish the room.
  2. Point toward textured furniture, frames or a doorway rather than straight at a mirror or a blank wall.
  3. Face mirrors, glass doors and large windows at an angle, with a frame or wall edge in the view. Reflections move as you move, and the 3D model cannot place them.
  4. Check mirrors for yourself and anyone else in the room. Anything reflected can appear in the walkthrough.

If it doesn’t work

Add light appears when a view is too dark for detail. Turn on a light or open the door.

The phone check does not judge lighting, reflections or sharpness. The automatic check after upload does, and may flag an area as worth a look.

Still stuck? Email Veylet support

Write to support@veylet.com and a person replies. Say which step you were on, your iPhone or iPad model, and the app version from Account, then About. Never send passwords or sign-in links.
